fixes.what: (Non-blocking.) The 1206-1240 corrections remove only {region: Eastern Galicia} (the Lviv, Ivano-Frankivsk and Ternopil oblasts), so the Polish-side Przemysl land stays in Daniel's realm through 1240, then disappears in the new 1241 keyframe with no ledger loss and returns with the 1245 gain.
fixes.why: Gazetteer: the Przemysl 60 km disk has 37 cells inside the 1240 shape, 18 of them (about 4,400 km2, 2 percent of the shape) outside Eastern Galicia; the 1238 gain is 'Eastern Galicia minus Przemysl' and keyframe 8 removes the whole disk, so 1236-1240 and 1241 disagree. Kingdom page: the 1344 treaty 'secured the Principality of Peremyshl for the Crown of Poland'; Daniel page: after Yaroslav (17 August 1245) he 'finally took the remainder of Galicia'. Duchy of Sandomierz ledger/14 also gains Przemysl and Lubaczow in 1214.
fixes.fix: In keyframes 2-7 write the correction as {minus: [<Cliopatria shape>, {union: [{region: Eastern Galicia}, {place: Przemysl, km: 60}]}]}, so the Przemysl land is out from 1206 and comes back only with the 1245 gain; no ledger change needed.
